name: KubeletPodResourcesGet
description:
Enable the `Get` gRPC endpoint on kubelet's for Pod resources.
This API augments the [resource allocation reporting](/docs/concepts/extend-kubernetes/compute-storage-net/device-plugins/#monitoring-device-plugin-resources).

name: KubeletPodResourcesGetAllocatable
description:
Enable the kubelet's pod resources
`GetAllocatableResources` functionality. This API augments the
[resource allocation reporting](/docs/concepts/extend-kubernetes/compute-storage-net/device-plugins/#monitoring-device-plugin-resources)

name: KubeletSeparateDiskGC
description:
The split image filesystem feature enables kubelet to perform garbage collection
of images (read-only layers) and/or containers (writeable layers) deployed on
separate filesystems.

name: KubeletServiceAccountTokenForCredentialProviders
description: Enable kubelet to send the service account token bound to the pod for which the image is being pulled to the credential provider plugin.

name: KubeletTracing
description:
Add support for distributed tracing in the kubelet.
When enabled, kubelet CRI interface and authenticated http servers are instrumented to generate
OpenTelemetry trace spans.
See [Traces for Kubernetes System Components](/docs/concepts/cluster-administration/system-traces) for more details.

name: LegacyNodeRoleBehavior
description:
When disabled, legacy behavior in service load balancers and
node disruption will ignore the `node-role.kubernetes.io/master` label in favor of the
feature-specific labels provided by `NodeDisruptionExclusion` and `ServiceNodeExclusion`.

name: LegacyServiceAccountTokenCleanUp
description:
Enable cleaning up Secret-based
[service account tokens](/docs/concepts/security/service-accounts/#get-a-token)
when they are not used in a specified time (default to be one year).

name: LegacyServiceAccountTokenNoAutoGeneration
description:
Stop auto-generation of Secret-based
[service account tokens](/docs/concepts/security/service-accounts/#get-a-token).

name: LegacyServiceAccountTokenTracking
description:
Track usage of Secret-based
[service account tokens](/docs/concepts/security/service-accounts/#get-a-token).

name: ListFromCacheSnapshot
description: Enables the API server to generate snapshots for the watch cache store and using them to serve LIST requests.

name: LoadBalancerIPMode
description:
Allows setting `ipMode` for Services where `type` is set to `LoadBalancer`.
See [Specifying IPMode of load balancer status](/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#load-balancer-ip-mode)
for more information.

name: LocalStorageCapacityIsolation
description:
Enable the consumption of
[local ephemeral storage](/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/)
and also the `sizeLimit` property of an
[emptyDir volume](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#emptydir).

name: LocalStorageCapacityIsolationFSQuotaMonitoring
description:
When `LocalStorageCapacityIsolation` 
is enabled for 
[local ephemeral storage](/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/), 
the backing filesystem for [emptyDir volumes](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#emptydir) supports project quotas,
and `UserNamespacesSupport` is enabled, 
project quotas are used to monitor `emptyDir` volume storage consumption rather than using filesystem walk, ensuring better performance and accuracy.

name: LogarithmicScaleDown
description:
Enable semi-random selection of pods to evict on controller scaledown
based on logarithmic bucketing of pod timestamps.

name: LoggingAlphaOptions
description: Allow fine-tuning of experimental, alpha-quality logging options.

name: LoggingBetaOptions
description: Allow fine-tuning of experimental, beta-quality logging options.

name: ManifestBasedAdmissionControlConfig
description:
Enable loading admission webhooks and CEL-based admission policies from
static manifest files on disk via the `staticManifestsDir` field in
`AdmissionConfiguration`. These policies are active from API server startup,
survive etcd unavailability, and can protect API-based admission resources
from modification.

name: MatchLabelKeysInPodAffinity
description:
Enable the `matchLabelKeys` and `mismatchLabelKeys` fields for
[pod (anti)affinity](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/).

name: MatchLabelKeysInPodTopologySpread
description:
Enable the `matchLabelKeys` field for
[Pod topology spread constraints](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/topology-spread-constraints/).

name: MatchLabelKeysInPodTopologySpreadSelectorMerge
description:
Enable merging of selectors built from `matchLabelKeys` into `labelSelector` of 
[Pod topology spread constraints](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/topology-spread-constraints/).
This feature gate can be enabled when `matchLabelKeys` feature is enabled with the `MatchLabelKeysInPodTopologySpread` feature flag.

name: MaxUnavailableStatefulSet
description:
Enables setting the `maxUnavailable` field for the
[rolling update strategy](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/statefulset/#rolling-updates)
of a StatefulSet. The field specifies the maximum number of Pods
that can be unavailable during the update.

name: MemoryManager
description:
Allows setting memory affinity for a container based on
NUMA topology.

name: MemoryQoS
description:
Enable memory protection and usage throttling for Pods and containers using
the cgroup v2 memory controller. When `memoryThrottlingFactor` is set, the
`kubelet` sets `memory.high` for throttling on Burstable and BestEffort
containers. The `kubelet` optionally sets `memory.min` and `memory.low` for
tiered memory protection when `memoryReservationPolicy` is set to
`TieredReservation`. Feature requires both - feature gate enablement and
`kubelet` configuration setting.

name: MinDomainsInPodTopologySpread
description:
Enable `minDomains` in
[Pod topology spread constraints](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/topology-spread-constraints/).

name: MinimizeIPTablesRestore
description:
Enables new performance improvement logics
in the kube-proxy iptables mode.

name: MixedProtocolLBService
description:
Enable using different protocols in the same `LoadBalancer` type
Service instance.

name: MountContainers
description: Enable using utility containers on host as the volume mounter.

name: MountPropagation
description:
Enable sharing volume mounted by one container to other containers or pods.
For more details, please see [mount propagation](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#mount-propagation).

name: MultiCIDRRangeAllocator
description: Enables the MultiCIDR range allocator.

name: MultiCIDRServiceAllocator
description: Track IP address allocations for Service cluster IPs using IPAddress objects.

name: MutableCSINodeAllocatableCount
description:
Make the `.spec.drivers[*].allocatable.count` field of a CSINode mutable.
Also, enable a CSIDriver field, `nodeAllocatableUpdatePeriodSeconds`.

This allows periodic updates to a node's reported allocatable volume capacity,
preventing stateful pods from becoming stuck due to outdated information
that the kube-scheduler would otherwise rely upon.

name: MutablePVNodeAffinity
description:
Allow update to the `.spec.nodeAffinity` field of a PersistentVolume.
See [Updates to node affinity](/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/#updates-to-node-affinity) for more details.

name: MutablePodResourcesForSuspendedJobs
description: Enable the ability to patch pod templates for suspended Jobs, in order to change requests or limits for infrastructure resources.

name: MutableSchedulingDirectivesForSuspendedJobs
description: Enable the ability to patch pod templates for suspended Jobs, in order to change the pod scheduling directives.

name: MutatingAdmissionPolicy
description:
Enable [MutatingAdmissionPolicy](/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/mutating-admission-policy/) support, which allows
[CEL](/docs/reference/using-api/cel/) mutations to
be applied during admission control.

For Kubernetes v1.30 and v1.31, this feature gate existed but had no effect.

name: NFTablesProxyMode
description: Allow running kube-proxy in [nftables mode](/docs/reference/networking/virtual-ips/#proxy-mode-nftables).

name: NamespaceDefaultLabelName
description:
Configure the API Server to set an immutable
{{< glossary_tooltip text="label" term_id="label" >}} `kubernetes.io/metadata.name`
on all namespaces, containing the namespace name.

name: NativeHistograms
description:
Enables Kubernetes components to expose metrics in Prometheus Native Histogram format for improved efficiency and finer bucket resolution.
See [Native Histograms](/docs/reference/instrumentation/native-histograms/) for more information.

name: NetworkPolicyEndPort
description:
Allows you to define ports in a
[NetworkPolicy](/docs/concepts/services-networking/network-policies/)
rule as a range of port numbers.

name: NetworkPolicyStatus
description: Enable the `status` subresource for NetworkPolicy objects.

name: NewVolumeManagerReconstruction
description:
Enables improved discovery of mounted volumes during kubelet
startup. Since the associated code had been significantly refactored, Kubernetes versions 1.25 to 1.29
allowed you to opt-out in case the kubelet got stuck at the startup, or did not unmount volumes
from terminated Pods.

This refactoring was behind the `SELinuxMountReadWriteOncePod`  feature gate in Kubernetes
releases 1.25 and 1.26.

name: NodeDeclaredFeatures
description:
Enables Nodes to report supported features via their `.status`. This enables the
scheduler and admission controller to prevent operations on nodes lacking features
required by the Pod. See [Node Declared Features](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/node-declared-features/).

name: NodeDisruptionExclusion
description:
Enable use of the Node label `node.kubernetes.io/exclude-disruption`
which prevents nodes from being evacuated during zone failures.

name: NodeInclusionPolicyInPodTopologySpread
description:
Enable using `nodeAffinityPolicy` and `nodeTaintsPolicy` in
[Pod topology spread constraints](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/topology-spread-constraints/)
when calculating pod topology spread skew.

name: NodeLease
description: Enable the new Lease API to report node heartbeats, which could be used as a node health signal.

name: NodeLifecycleConditions
description:
Enables well-known Node conditions that report drain, maintenance, and
[Graceful Node Shutdown](/docs/concepts/cluster-administration/node-shutdown/)
lifecycle state. See
[Node lifecycle conditions](/docs/reference/node/node-lifecycle-conditions/).

name: NodeLogQuery
description: Enables querying logs of node services using the `/logs` endpoint.

name: NodeOutOfServiceVolumeDetach
description:
When a Node is marked out-of-service using the
`node.kubernetes.io/out-of-service` taint, Pods on the node will be forcefully deleted
 if they can not tolerate this taint, and the volume detach operations for Pods terminating
 on the node will happen immediately. The deleted Pods can recover quickly on different nodes.

name: NodeSwap
description:
Enable the kubelet to allocate swap memory for Kubernetes workloads on a node.
Must be used with `KubeletConfiguration.failSwapOn` set to false.
For more details, please see [swap memory](/docs/concepts/architecture/nodes/#swap-memory)

name: NominatedNodeNameForExpectation
description:
When enabled, kube-scheduler uses `.status.nominatedNodeName` to express where a
Pod is going to be bound. The `.status.nominatedNodeName` field is set when kube-scheduler
triggers preemption of pods, or anticipates that WaitOnPermit or PreBinding phase will take
relatively long.
Other components may read and use `.status.nominatedNodeName`, but should not set it.

When disabled, kube-scheduler will only set `.status.nominatedNodeName` before triggering preemption.

name: NonPreemptingPriority
description: Enable `preemptionPolicy` field for PriorityClass and Pod.

name: OpenAPIEnums
description:
Enables populating "enum" fields of OpenAPI schemas in the
spec returned from the API server.

name: OpenAPIV3
description: Enables the API server to publish OpenAPI v3.

name: OpportunisticBatching
description: Enable reusing of scheduling results from the previous scheduling cycle for equivalent pods.

name: OrderedNamespaceDeletion
description: While deleting namespace, the pods resources is going to be deleted before the rest of resources.

name: PDBUnhealthyPodEvictionPolicy
description:
Enables the `unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy` field of a `PodDisruptionBudget`. This specifies
when unhealthy pods should be considered for eviction. Please see [Unhealthy Pod Eviction Policy](/docs/tasks/run-application/configure-pdb/#unhealthy-pod-eviction-policy)
for more details.

name: PVCProtection
description:
Enable the prevention of a PersistentVolumeClaim (PVC) from
being deleted when it is still used by any Pod.

name: PersistentLocalVolumes
description:
Enable the usage of `local` volume type in Pods.
Pod affinity has to be specified if requesting a `local` volume.

name: PersistentVolumeClaimUnusedSinceTime
description:
When enabled, the PVC protection controller adds an `Unused` condition to
PersistentVolumeClaims that tracks whether the PVC is currently referenced by
any non-terminal Pod. The condition's `lastTransitionTime` records when the PVC
last transitioned between being in use and being unused.

name: PersistentVolumeLastPhaseTransitionTime
description:
Adds a new field to PersistentVolume
which holds a timestamp of when the volume last transitioned its phase.

name: PodAffinityNamespaceSelector
description:
Enable the
[Pod Affinity Namespace Selector](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/#namespace-selector)
and [CrossNamespacePodAffinity](/docs/concepts/policy/resource-quotas/#cross-namespace-pod-affinity-quota)
quota scope features.

name: PodAndContainerStatsFromCRI
description:
Configure the kubelet to gather container and pod stats from the CRI container runtime rather than gathering them from cAdvisor.
As of 1.26, this also includes gathering metrics from CRI and emitting them over `/metrics/cadvisor` (rather than having cAdvisor emit them directly).

name: PodCertificateRequest
description:
Enable PodCertificateRequest objects and podCertificate projected volume
sources.

name: PodDeletionCost
description:
Enable the [Pod Deletion Cost](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/replicaset/#pod-deletion-cost)
 feature which allows users to influence ReplicaSet downscaling order.

name: PodDisruptionBudget
description: Enable the [PodDisruptionBudget](/docs/tasks/run-application/configure-pdb/) feature.

name: PodDisruptionConditions
description: Enabled support for appending a dedicated pod condition indicating that the pod is being deleted due to a disruption.

name: PodGroupPreemptionPolicy
description:
Enables the support for `PreemptionPolicy` field in [PodGroup API](/docs/concepts/workloads/podgroup-api/) and [Workload API](/docs/concepts/workloads/workload-api/).

When enabled, if a PodGroup has `PreemptionPolicy: Never` it will not perform workload aware preemption.

name: PodHasNetworkCondition
description:
Enable the kubelet to mark the [PodHasNetwork](/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-lifecycle/#pod-has-network)
condition on pods. This was renamed to `PodReadyToStartContainersCondition` in 1.28.

name: PodHostIPs
description:
Enable the `status.hostIPs` field for pods and the {{< glossary_tooltip term_id="downward-api" text="downward API" >}}.
The field lets you expose host IP addresses to workloads.

name: PodIndexLabel
description: Enables the Job controller and StatefulSet controller to add the pod index as a label when creating new pods. See [Job completion mode docs](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/job#completion-mode) and [StatefulSet pod index label docs](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/statefulset/#pod-index-label) for more details.

name: PodLevelResourceManagers
description:
Enable _Pod-level resource managers_: the ability for the Topology, CPU, and
Memory managers to use information from `.spec.resources` to perform NUMA
alignment for an entire pod and manage resources flexibly for the containers
within that pod.

name: PodLevelResources
description:
Enable _Pod level resources_:  the ability to specify resource requests and limits
at the Pod level, rather than only for specific containers.

name: PodLifecycleSleepAction
description: Enables the `sleep` action in Container lifecycle hooks (`preStop` and `postStart`).

name: PodLifecycleSleepActionAllowZero
description:
Enables setting zero value for the `sleep` action in
[container lifecycle hooks](/docs/concepts/containers/container-lifecycle-hooks/).

name: PodLogsQuerySplitStreams
description: Enable fetching specific log streams (either stdout or stderr) from a container's log streams, using the Pod API.

name: PodObservedGenerationTracking
description:
Enables the kubelet to set `observedGeneration` in the Pod `.status`, and enables other components to set `observedGeneration` in pod conditions.
This feature allows reflecting the `.metadata.generation` of the Pod at the time that the overall status, or some specific condition, was being recorded.
Storing it helps avoid risks associated with _lost updates_.

name: PodOverhead
description:
Enable the [PodOverhead](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/pod-overhead/)
feature to account for pod overheads.

name: PodPriority
description:
Enable the descheduling and preemption of Pods based on their
[priorities](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/pod-priority-preemption/).

name: PodReadinessGates
description:
Enable the setting of `PodReadinessGate` field for extending
Pod readiness evaluation. See [Pod readiness gate](/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-lifecycle/#pod-readiness-gate)
for more details.

name: PodReadyToStartContainersCondition
description:
Enable the kubelet to mark the [PodReadyToStartContainers](/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-lifecycle/#pod-has-network) condition on pods.

This feature gate was previously known as `PodHasNetworkCondition`, and the associated condition was
named `PodHasNetwork`.

name: PodSchedulingReadiness
description: Enable setting `schedulingGates` field to control a Pod's [scheduling readiness](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/pod-scheduling-readiness).

name: PodSecurity
description: Enables the `PodSecurity` admission plugin.

name: PodShareProcessNamespace
description:
Enable the setting of `shareProcessNamespace` in a Pod for sharing
a single process namespace between containers running in a pod.  More details can be found in
[Share Process Namespace between Containers in a Pod](/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/share-process-namespace/).

name: PodTopologyLabelsAdmission
description:
Enables the `PodTopologyLabels` admission plugin.
See [Pod Topology Labels](/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/admission-controllers#podtopologylabels)
for details.

name: PodsAPI
description:
Enables the kubelet Pods API gRPC service.
See [Kubelet Pods API](/docs/reference/node/kubelet-pods-api/) for more details.

name: PortForwardWebsockets
description:
Allow WebSocket streaming of the
portforward sub-protocol (`port-forward`) from clients requesting
version v2 (`v2.portforward.k8s.io`) of the sub-protocol.

name: PreferNominatedNode
description:
This flag tells the scheduler whether the nominated
nodes will be checked first before looping through all the other nodes in
the cluster.

name: PreferSameTrafficDistribution
description:
Allows usage of the values `PreferSameZone` and `PreferSameNode` in
the Service [`trafficDistribution`](/docs/reference/networking/virtual-ips/#traffic-distribution)
field.

name: PreventStaticPodAPIReferences
description: Denies Pod admission if static Pods reference other API objects.

name: ProbeTerminationGracePeriod
description:
Enable [setting probe-level
`terminationGracePeriodSeconds`](/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/#probe-level-terminationgraceperiodseconds)
on pods. See the [enhancement proposal](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/master/keps/sig-node/2238-liveness-probe-grace-period)
for more details.

name: ProcMountType
description:
Enables control over the type proc mounts for containers
by setting the `procMount` field of a Pod's `securityContext`.

name: ProxyTerminatingEndpoints
description:
Enable the kube-proxy to handle terminating
endpoints when `ExternalTrafficPolicy=Local`.

name: QOSReserved
description:
Allows resource reservations at the QoS level preventing pods
at lower QoS levels from bursting into resources requested at higher QoS levels
(memory only for now).

name: ReadOnlyAPIDataVolumes
description:
Set [`configMap`](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#configmap), 
[`secret`](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#secret), 
[`downwardAPI`](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#downwardapi) and 
[`projected`](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#projected) 
{{< glossary_tooltip term_id="volume" text="volumes" >}} to be mounted read-only.

Since Kubernetes v1.10, these volume types are always read-only and you cannot opt out.

name: ReadWriteOncePod
description:
Enables the usage of `ReadWriteOncePod` PersistentVolume
access mode.

name: RecoverVolumeExpansionFailure
description:
Enables users to edit their PVCs to smaller
sizes so as they can recover from previously issued volume expansion failures.
See [Recovering from Failure when Expanding Volumes](/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/#recovering-from-failure-when-expanding-volumes)
for more details.

name: RecursiveReadOnlyMounts
description:
Enables support for recursive read-only mounts.
For more details, see [read-only mounts](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#read-only-mounts).

name: ReduceDefaultCrashLoopBackOffDecay
description:
Enabled reduction of both the initial delay and the maximum delay accrued
between container restarts for a node for containers in `CrashLoopBackOff`
across the cluster to `1s` initial delay and `60s` maximum delay.

name: RelaxedDNSSearchValidation
description:
Relax the server side validation for the DNS search string
(`.spec.dnsConfig.searches`) for containers. For example,
with this gate enabled, it is okay to include the `_` character
in the DNS name search string.

name: RelaxedEnvironmentVariableValidation
description: Allow almost all printable ASCII characters in environment variables.

name: RelaxedServiceNameValidation
description:
Enables relaxed validation for Service object names, allowing the use of [RFC 1123 label names](/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#dns-label-names) instead of [RFC 1035 label names](/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#rfc-1035-label-names).

This feature allows Service object names to start with a digit.

name: ReloadKubeletServerCertificateFile
description:
Enable the kubelet TLS server to update its certificate if the specified certificate file are changed.

This feature is useful when specifying `tlsCertFile` and `tlsPrivateKeyFile` in kubelet configuration.
The feature gate has no effect for other cases such as using TLS bootstrap.

name: RemainingItemCount
description:
Allow the API servers to show a count of remaining
items in the response to a
[chunking list request](/docs/reference/using-api/api-concepts/#retrieving-large-results-sets-in-chunks).

name: RemoteRequestHeaderUID
description:
Enable the API server to accept UIDs (user IDs) via request header authentication.
This will also make the `kube-apiserver`'s API aggregator add UIDs via standard headers when
forwarding requests to the servers serving the aggregated API.

name: RemoveSelfLink
description:
Sets the `.metadata.selfLink` field to blank (empty string) for all
objects and collections. This field has been deprecated since the Kubernetes v1.16
release. When this feature is enabled, the `.metadata.selfLink` field remains part of
the Kubernetes API, but is always unset.

name: RequestManagement
description:
Enables managing request concurrency with prioritization and fairness
at each API server. Deprecated by `APIPriorityAndFairness` since 1.17.

name: ResilientWatchCacheInitialization
description: Enables resilient watchcache initialization to avoid controlplane overload.

name: ResourceHealthStatus
description:
Enable the `allocatedResourcesStatus` field within the `.status` for a Pod. The field
reports additional details for each container in the Pod,
with the health information for each device assigned to the Pod.

Starting in v1.36 (beta), the health report includes an optional `message` field that
provides additional human-readable context about the health status, such as error details
or failure reasons.

This feature applies to devices managed by both [Device Plugins](/docs/concepts/extend-kubernetes/compute-storage-net/device-plugins/#device-plugin-and-unhealthy-devices) and [Dynamic Resource Allocation](/docs/concepts/resource-management/dynamic-resource-allocation/dra-observability/#device-health-monitoring). See [Device plugin and unhealthy devices](/docs/concepts/extend-kubernetes/compute-storage-net/device-plugins/#device-plugin-and-unhealthy-devices) for more details.

name: ResourceLimitsPriorityFunction
description:
Enable a scheduler priority function that
assigns a lowest possible score of 1 to a node that satisfies at least one of
the input Pod's cpu and memory limits. The intent is to break ties between
nodes with same scores.

name: ResourceQuotaScopeSelectors
description: Enable resource quota scope selectors.

name: RestartAllContainersOnContainerExits
description:
Enables the ability to specify
`RestartAllContainers` as an action in container `restartPolicyRules`. When a container's exit matches a rule with this action, the entire Pod is terminated and restarted in-place.

`RestartAllContainersOnContainerExits` depends on both the `ContainerRestartRules` and `NodeDeclaredFeatures` feature gates. If the dependent feature gates are not enabled, kubelet startup can fail.

See [Restart All Containers](/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-lifecycle/#restart-all-containers) for more details.

name: RetroactiveDefaultStorageClass
description: Allow assigning StorageClass to unbound PVCs retroactively.

name: RetryGenerateName
description:
Enables retrying of object creation when the
{{< glossary_tooltip text="API server" term_id="kube-apiserver" >}}
is expected to generate a [name](/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names).

When this feature is enabled, requests using `generateName` are retried automatically in case the
control plane detects a name conflict with an existing object, up to a limit of 8 total attempts.

name: RootCAConfigMap
description:
Configure the `kube-controller-manager` to publish a
{{< glossary_tooltip text="ConfigMap" term_id="configmap" >}} named `kube-root-ca.crt`
to every namespace. This ConfigMap contains a CA bundle used for verifying connections
to the kube-apiserver. See
[Bound Service Account Tokens](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/blob/master/keps/sig-auth/1205-bound-service-account-tokens/README.md)
for more details.

name: RotateKubeletClientCertificate
description:
Enable the rotation of the client TLS certificate on the kubelet.
See [kubelet configuration](/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/kubelet-tls-bootstrapping/#kubelet-configuration)
for more details.

name: RotateKubeletServerCertificate
description:
Enable the rotation of the server TLS certificate on the kubelet.
See [kubelet configuration](/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/kubelet-tls-bootstrapping/#kubelet-configuration)
for more details.

name: RunAsGroup
description: Enable control over the primary group ID set on the init processes of containers.

name: RuntimeClass
description:
Enable the [RuntimeClass](/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/) feature for
selecting container runtime configurations.

name: RuntimeClassInImageCriApi
description:
Enables images to be pulled based on the [runtime class](/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/)
of the pods that reference them.

name: SCTPSupport
description:
Enables the _SCTP_ `protocol` value in Pod, Service, Endpoints, EndpointSlice,
and NetworkPolicy definitions.

name: SELinuxChangePolicy
description:
Enables `spec.securityContext.seLinuxChangePolicy` field.
This field can be used to opt-out from applying the SELinux label to the pod
volumes using mount options. This is required when a single volume that supports
mounting with SELinux mount option is shared between Pods that have different
SELinux labels, such as a privileged and unprivileged Pods.

Enabling the `SELinuxChangePolicy` feature gate requires the feature gate `SELinuxMountReadWriteOncePod` to
be enabled.

name: SELinuxMount
description:
Speeds up container startup by allowing kubelet to mount volumes
for a Pod directly with the correct SELinux label instead of changing each file on the volumes
recursively.
It widens the performance improvements behind the `SELinuxMountReadWriteOncePod`
feature gate by extending the implementation to all volumes.

name: SELinuxMountReadWriteOncePod
description:
Speeds up container startup by allowing kubelet to mount volumes
for a Pod directly with the correct SELinux label instead of changing each file on the volumes
recursively. The initial implementation focused on ReadWriteOncePod volumes.

name: ScheduleDaemonSetPods
description:
Enable DaemonSet Pods to be scheduled by the default scheduler instead
of the DaemonSet controller.

name: SchedulerAsyncAPICalls
description:
Change the kube-scheduler to make the entire scheduling cycle free of blocking requests to the Kubernetes API server.
Instead, interact with the Kubernetes API using asynchronous code.

name: SchedulerAsyncPreemption
description:
Enable running some expensive operations within the scheduler, associated with
[preemption](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/pod-priority-preemption/), asynchronously.
Asynchronous processing of preemption improves overall Pod scheduling latency.

name: SchedulerPopFromBackoffQ
description:
Improves scheduling queue behavior by popping pods from the backoffQ when the activeQ is empty.
This allows to process potentially schedulable pods ASAP, eliminating a penalty effect of the backoff queue.

name: SchedulerQueueingHints
description:
Enables scheduler [queueing hints](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/scheduling-framework/#queueinghint),
which benefits to reduce the useless requeuing.
The scheduler retries scheduling pods if something changes in the cluster that could make the pod scheduled.
Queueing hints are internal signals that allow the scheduler to filter the changes in the cluster
that are relevant to the unscheduled pod, based on previous scheduling attempts.

name: SeccompDefault
description:
Enables the use of `RuntimeDefault` as the default seccomp profile
for all workloads.
The seccomp profile is specified in the `securityContext` of a Pod and/or a Container.

name: SecurityContextDeny
description: This gate signals that the `SecurityContextDeny` admission controller is deprecated.

name: SelectorIndex
description:
Allows label and field based indexes in API server watch cache to accelerate
list operations.

name: SeparateCacheWatchRPC
description:
Allows the API server watch cache to create a watch on a dedicated RPC.
This prevents watch cache from being starved by other watches.

name: SeparateTaintEvictionController
description:
Enables running the _taint based eviction_ controller,
that performs [Taint-based Evictions](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/taint-and-toleration/#taint-based-evictions),
as a standalone controller (separate from the _node lifecycle_ controller).

name: ServerSideApply
description:
Enables the [Sever Side Apply (SSA)](/docs/reference/using-api/server-side-apply/)
feature on the API Server.

name: ServerSideFieldValidation
description:
Enables server-side field validation. This means the validation
of resource schema is performed at the API server side rather than the client side
(for example, the `kubectl create` or `kubectl apply` command line).

name: ServiceAccountIssuerDiscovery
description:
Enable OIDC discovery endpoints (issuer and JWKS URLs) for the
service account issuer in the API server. See
[Configure Service Accounts for Pods](/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-service-account/#service-account-issuer-discovery)
for more details.

name: ServiceAccountNodeAudienceRestriction
description: This gate is used to restrict the audience for which the kubelet can request a service account token for.

name: ServiceAccountTokenJTI
description:
Controls whether JTIs (UUIDs) are embedded into generated service account tokens,
and whether these JTIs are recorded into the Kubernetes audit log for future requests made by these tokens.

name: ServiceAccountTokenNodeBinding
description: Controls whether the API server allows binding service account tokens to Node objects.

name: ServiceAccountTokenNodeBindingValidation
description: Controls whether the apiserver will validate a Node reference in service account tokens.

name: ServiceAccountTokenPodNodeInfo
description:
Controls whether the apiserver embeds the node name and uid
for the associated node when issuing service account tokens bound to Pod objects.

name: ServiceAppProtocol
description: Enables the `appProtocol` field on Services and Endpoints.

name: ServiceIPStaticSubrange
description:
Enables a strategy for Services ClusterIP allocations, whereby the
ClusterIP range is subdivided. Dynamic allocated ClusterIP addresses will be allocated preferently
from the upper range allowing users to assign static ClusterIPs from the lower range with a low
risk of collision. See
[Avoiding collisions](/docs/reference/networking/virtual-ips/#avoiding-collisions)
for more details.

name: ServiceInternalTrafficPolicy
description: Enables the `internalTrafficPolicy` field on Services

name: ServiceLBNodePortControl
description: Enables the `allocateLoadBalancerNodePorts` field on Services.

name: ServiceLoadBalancerClass
description:
Enables the `loadBalancerClass` field on Services. See
[Specifying class of load balancer implementation](/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#load-balancer-class)
for more details.

name: ServiceLoadBalancerFinalizer
description: Enable finalizer protection for Service load balancers.

name: ServiceNodeExclusion
description:
Enable the exclusion of nodes from load balancers created by a cloud provider.
A node is eligible for exclusion if labelled with "`node.kubernetes.io/exclude-from-external-load-balancers`".

name: ServiceNodePortStaticSubrange
description:
Enables the use of different port allocation
strategies for NodePort Services. For more details, see
[reserve NodePort ranges to avoid collisions](/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#avoid-nodeport-collisions).

name: ServiceTopology
description: Enable service to route traffic based upon the Node topology of the cluster.

name: ServiceTrafficDistribution
description:
Allows usage of the optional `spec.trafficDistribution` field in Services. The
field offers a way to express preferences for how traffic is distributed to
Service endpoints.

name: SetHostnameAsFQDN
description:
Enable the ability of setting Fully Qualified Domain Name(FQDN) as the
hostname of a pod. See
[Pod's `setHostnameAsFQDN` field](/docs/concepts/services-networking/dns-pod-service/#pod-sethostnameasfqdn-field).

name: ShardedListAndWatch
description:
Enable support for the `shardSelector` parameter on **list** and **watch** requests,
allowing clients to receive a filtered subset of objects based on hash ranges of
metadata fields (such as UID). See
[Sharded list and watch](/docs/reference/using-api/api-concepts/#sharded-list-and-watch)
for more details.

name: SidecarContainers
description:
Allow setting the `restartPolicy` of an init container to
`Always` so that the container becomes a sidecar container (restartable init containers).
See [Sidecar containers and restartPolicy](/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/sidecar-containers/)
for more details.

name: SizeBasedListCostEstimate
description: Enables APF to use size of objects for estimating request cost.

name: SizeMemoryBackedVolumes
description:
Enable kubelets to determine the size limit for
memory-backed volumes (mainly `emptyDir` volumes).

name: SkipReadOnlyValidationGCE
description: Skip validation that GCE PersistentDisk volumes are in read-only mode.

name: StableLoadBalancerNodeSet
description:
Enables less load balancer re-configurations by
the service controller (KCCM) as an effect of changing node state.

name: StaleControllerConsistencyDaemonSet
description:
Enables behavior within the DaemonSet controller to ensure that prior writes to
the API server are observed before proceeding with additional reconciliation for the same DaemonSet.
This is to prevent stale cache from causing incorrect or spurious updates to the DaemonSet.

name: StaleControllerConsistencyJob
description:
Enables behavior within the Job controller to ensure that prior writes to
the API server are observed before proceeding with additional reconciliation for the same Job.
This is to prevent stale cache from causing incorrect or spurious updates to the Job.

name: StaleControllerConsistencyReplicaSet
description:
Enables behavior within the ReplicaSet controller to ensure that prior writes to
the API server are observed before proceeding with additional reconciliation for the same ReplicaSet.
This is to prevent stale cache from causing incorrect or spurious updates to the ReplicaSet.

name: StaleControllerConsistencyStatefulSet
description:
Enables behavior within the StatefulSet controller to ensure that prior writes to
the API server are observed before proceeding with additional reconciliation for the same StatefulSet.
This is to prevent stale cache from causing incorrect or spurious updates to the StatefulSet.

name: StartupProbe
description:
Enable the [startup](/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-lifecycle/#when-should-you-use-a-startup-probe)
probe in the kubelet.

name: StatefulSetAutoDeletePVC
description:
Allows the use of the optional `.spec.persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy` field, 
providing control over the deletion of PVCs in a StatefulSet's lifecycle.
See
[PersistentVolumeClaim retention](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/statefulset/#persistentvolumeclaim-retention)
for more details.

name: StatefulSetMinReadySeconds
description:
Allows `minReadySeconds` to be respected by
the StatefulSet controller.

name: StatefulSetRecreateStrategy
description:
Enables the `Recreate` update strategy for StatefulSets, which deletes all of a
StatefulSet's Pods before creating new Pods that reflect modifications made to the
StatefulSet's `.spec.template`. See
[Recreate](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/statefulset/#recreate) for details.

name: StatefulSetStartOrdinal
description:
Allow configuration of the start ordinal in a
StatefulSet. See
[Start ordinal](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/statefulset/#start-ordinal)
for more details.

name: StorageCapacityScoring
description:
The feature gate `VolumeCapacityPriority` was used in v1.32 to support storage that are
statically provisioned. Starting from v1.33, the new feature gate `StorageCapacityScoring`
replaces the old `VolumeCapacityPriority` gate with added support to dynamically provisioned storage.
When `StorageCapacityScoring` is enabled, the VolumeBinding plugin in the kube-scheduler is extended
to score Nodes based on the storage capacity on each of them.
This feature is applicable to CSI volumes that supported [Storage Capacity](/docs/concepts/storage/storage-capacity/),
including local storage backed by a CSI driver.

name: StorageNamespaceIndex
description:
Enables a namespace indexer for namespace scoped resources
in API server cache to accelerate list operations.

name: StorageObjectInUseProtection
description:
Postpone the deletion of PersistentVolume or
PersistentVolumeClaim objects if they are still being used.

name: StorageVersionAPI
description:
Enable the
[storage version API](/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/{{< param "version" >}}/#storageversion-v1alpha1-internal-apiserver-k8s-io).

name: StorageVersionHash
description:
Allow API servers to expose the storage version hash in the
discovery.

name: StorageVersionMigrator
description:
Enables the migration of the [storage
version](/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/storage-version) of a
resource.

name: StreamingCollectionEncodingToJSON
description: Allow the API server JSON encoder to encode collections item by item, instead of all at once.

name: StreamingCollectionEncodingToProtobuf
description: Allow the API server Protobuf encoder to encode collections item by item, instead of all at once.

name: StreamingProxyRedirects
description:
Instructs the API server to intercept (and follow) redirects from the
backend (kubelet) for streaming requests. Examples of streaming requests include the `exec`,
`attach` and `port-forward` requests.

name: StrictCostEnforcementForVAP
description: Apply strict CEL cost validation for ValidatingAdmissionPolicies.

name: StrictCostEnforcementForWebhooks
description:
Apply strict CEL cost validation for `matchConditions` within
admission webhooks.

name: StrictIPCIDRValidation
description:
Use stricter validation for fields containing IP addresses and CIDR values.

In particular, with this feature gate enabled, octets within IPv4 addresses are
not allowed to have any leading `0`s, and IPv4-mapped IPv6 values (e.g.
`::ffff:192.168.0.1`) are forbidden. These sorts of values can potentially cause
security problems when different components interpret the same string as
referring to different IP addresses (as in CVE-2021-29923).

This tightening applies only to fields in build-in API kinds, and not to
custom resource kinds, values in Kubernetes configuration files, or
command-line arguments.

name: StructuredAuthenticationConfiguration
description:
Enable [structured authentication configuration](/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/authentication/#configuring-the-api-server)
for the API server.

name: StructuredAuthenticationConfigurationEgressSelector
description: Enables Egress Selector in Structured Authentication Configuration.

name: StructuredAuthenticationConfigurationJWKSMetrics
description:
Enables additional metrics for JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) operations in JWT authenticators
configured via `--authentication-config`. When enabled, the API server records metrics about
the last time JWKS was fetched and the hash value of the JWKS response.
See the [metrics reference](/docs/reference/instrumentation/metrics/) for details.

name: StructuredAuthorizationConfiguration
description:
Enable structured authorization configuration, so that cluster administrators
can specify more than one [authorization webhook](/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/webhook/)
in the API server handler chain.

name: SupplementalGroupsPolicy
description:
Enables support for fine-grained SupplementalGroups control.
For more details, see [Configure fine-grained SupplementalGroups control for a Pod](/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/#supplementalgroupspolicy).

name: SupportIPVSProxyMode
description:
Enable providing in-cluster service load balancing using IPVS.
See [service proxies](/docs/reference/networking/virtual-ips/) for more details.

name: SupportNodePidsLimit
description:
Enable the support to limiting PIDs on the Node.  The parameter
`pid=<number>` in the `--system-reserved` and `--kube-reserved` options can be specified to
ensure that the specified number of process IDs will be reserved for the system as a whole and for
 Kubernetes system daemons respectively.

name: SupportPodPidsLimit
description: Enable the support to limiting PIDs in Pods.

name: SuspendJob
description:
Enable support to suspend and resume Jobs. For more details, see
 [the Jobs docs](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/job/).

name: Sysctls
description:
Enable support for namespaced kernel parameters (sysctls) that can be set for each pod.
See [sysctls](/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/sysctl-cluster/) for more details.

name: SystemdWatchdog
description:
Allow using systemd watchdog to monitor the health status of kubelet.
See [Kubelet Systemd Watchdog](/docs/reference/node/systemd-watchdog/)
for more details.

name: TTLAfterFinished
description:
Allow a [TTL controller](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/ttlafterfinished/)
to clean up resources after they finish execution.

name: TaintBasedEvictions
description:
Enable evicting pods from nodes based on taints on Nodes and tolerations
on Pods.  See [taints and tolerations](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/taint-and-toleration/)
for more details.

name: TaintNodesByCondition
description:
Enable automatic tainting nodes based on
[node conditions](/docs/concepts/architecture/nodes/#condition).

name: TaintTolerationComparisonOperators
description:
Enables numeric comparison operators (`Lt` and `Gt`) for
[tolerations](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/taint-and-toleration/).

name: TokenRequest
description: Enable the `TokenRequest` endpoint on service account resources.

name: TokenRequestProjection
description:
Enable the injection of service account tokens into a Pod through a
[`projected` volume](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#projected).

name: TokenRequestServiceAccountUIDValidation
description:
This is used to ensure that the UID provided in the TokenRequest matches
the UID of the ServiceAccount for which the token is being requested.
It helps prevent misuse of the TokenRequest API by ensuring that
tokens are only issued for the correct ServiceAccount.

name: TopologyAwareHints
description:
Enables topology aware routing based on topology hints
in EndpointSlices. See [Topology Aware
Hints](/docs/concepts/services-networking/topology-aware-routing/) for more
details.

name: TopologyAwareWorkloadScheduling
description: Enable topology-aware scheduling for Workloads.

name: TopologyManager
description:
Enable a mechanism to coordinate fine-grained hardware resource
assignments for different components in Kubernetes. See
[Control Topology Management Policies on a node](/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/topology-manager/).

name: TopologyManagerPolicyAlphaOptions
description:
Allow fine-tuning of topology manager policies,
experimental, Alpha-quality options.
This feature gate guards *a group* of topology manager options whose quality level is alpha.
This feature gate will never graduate to beta or stable.

name: TopologyManagerPolicyBetaOptions
description:
Allow fine-tuning of topology manager policies,
experimental, Beta-quality options.
This feature gate guards *a group* of topology manager options whose quality level is beta.
This feature gate will never graduate to stable.

name: TopologyManagerPolicyOptions
description:
Enable [fine-tuning](/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/topology-manager/#topology-manager-policy-options)
of topology manager policies.

name: TranslateStreamCloseWebsocketRequests
description:
Allow WebSocket streaming of the
remote command sub-protocol (`exec`, `cp`, `attach`) from clients requesting
version 5 (v5) of the sub-protocol.

name: UnauthenticatedHTTP2DOSMitigation
description:
Enables HTTP/2 Denial of Service (DoS) mitigations for unauthenticated clients.
Kubernetes v1.28.0 through v1.28.2 do not include this feature gate.

name: UnknownVersionInteroperabilityProxy
description:
Proxy resource requests to the correct peer kube-apiserver when
multiple kube-apiservers exist at varied versions.
See [Mixed version proxy](/docs/concepts/architecture/mixed-version-proxy/) for more information.

name: UnlockWhileProcessingFIFO
description:
Enable use of a FIFO queue within client-go that unlocks while processing events. If not enabled, 
the queue instead holds the lock for the entire duration of processing events, which could lead 
to performance issues in high-throughput scenarios. This feature gate can be toggled in the
kube-controller-manager and any client-go based controller.

You can only enable this feature gate if the
[AtomicFIFO](/docs/reference/command-line-tools-reference/feature-gates/#AtomicFIFO) feature gate is also enabled.

name: UserNamespacesHostNetworkSupport
description: When enabled, pods are allowed to use both `hostNetwork` and [User Namespaces](/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/user-namespaces) simultaneously.

name: UserNamespacesPodSecurityStandards
description:
Enable Pod Security Standards policies relaxation for pods
that run with namespaces. You must set the value of this feature gate consistently across all nodes in
your cluster, and you must also enable `UserNamespacesSupport` to use this feature.

This feature gate is not part of Kubernetes v1.35 (and onwards) because,
for those versions of Kubernetes, all supported kubelet versions will fail to
create a pod if it requests a user namespace, but the node does not.

name: UserNamespacesStatelessPodsSupport
description:
Enable user namespace support for stateless Pods. This feature gate was superseded
by the `UserNamespacesSupport` feature gate in the Kubernetes v1.28 release.

name: UserNamespacesSupport
description: Enable user namespace support for Pods.

name: ValidateProxyRedirects
description:
This flag controls whether the API server should validate that redirects
are only followed to the same host. Only used if the `StreamingProxyRedirects` flag is enabled.

name: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
description: Enable [ValidatingAdmissionPolicy](/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/validating-admission-policy/) support for CEL validations be used in Admission Control.

name: VolumeAttributesClass
description:
Enable support for VolumeAttributesClasses.
See [Volume Attributes Classes](/docs/concepts/storage/volume-attributes-classes/)
for more information.

name: VolumeBindMountOptions
description:
Enables setting bind mount options (`noexec`, `nodev`, `nosuid`) per container
volume mount using the `bindMountOptions` field in `volumeMounts`. When enabled,
the kubelet passes these options to the container runtime, which applies them as
Linux bind mount flags. The container runtime must support the `mount_options`
field in the CRI `Mount` message. This field has no effect on Windows nodes.

name: VolumeCapacityPriority
description:
Enable support for prioritizing nodes in different
topologies based on available PV capacity.
This feature is renamed to `StorageCapacityScoring` in v1.33.

name: VolumeLimitScaling
description:
Enables volume limit scaling for CSI drivers. This allows scheduler to
co-ordinate better with cluster-autoscaler for storage limits.
See [Storage Limits](/docs/concepts/storage/storage-limits/)
for more information.

name: VolumePVCDataSource
description: Enable support for specifying an existing PVC as a DataSource.

name: VolumeScheduling
description:
Enable volume topology aware scheduling and make the PersistentVolumeClaim
(PVC) binding aware of scheduling decisions. It also enables the usage of
[`local`](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#local) volume type when used together with the
`PersistentLocalVolumes` feature gate.

name: VolumeSnapshotDataSource
description: Enable volume snapshot data source support.

name: VolumeSubpath
description: Allow mounting a subpath of a volume in a container.

name: VolumeSubpathEnvExpansion
description:
Enable `subPathExpr` field for expanding environment
variables into a `subPath`.

name: WarningHeaders
description: Allow sending warning headers in API responses.

name: WatchBookmark
description: Enable support for watch bookmark events.

name: WatchCacheInitializationPostStartHook
description: Enables post-start-hook for watchcache initialization to be part of readyz (with timeout).

name: WatchFromStorageWithoutResourceVersion
description: Enables watches without `resourceVersion` to be served from storage.

name: WatchList
description: Enable support for [streaming initial state of objects in watch requests](/docs/reference/using-api/api-concepts/#streaming-lists).

name: WatchListClient
description:
Allows an API client to request a stream of data rather than fetching a full list. 
This functionality is available in `client-go` and requires the 
[WatchList](/docs/reference/command-line-tools-reference/feature-gates/) 
feature to be enabled on the server. 
If the `WatchList` is not supported on the server, the client will seamlessly fall back to a standard list request.

name: WatchListCompression
description:
Enables compression for
[_watch list_](/docs/reference/using-api/api-concepts/#streaming-lists)
responses from the API server.
This feature gate has no effect if `WatchList` is disabled.

name: WinDSR
description: Allows kube-proxy to create DSR loadbalancers for Windows.

name: WinOverlay
description: Allows kube-proxy to run in overlay mode for Windows.

name: WindowsCPUAndMemoryAffinity
description:
Add CPU and Memory Affinity support to Windows nodes with [CPUManager](/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/cpu-management-policies/#windows-support),
[MemoryManager](/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/memory-manager/#windows-support)
and topology manager.

name: WindowsEndpointSliceProxying
description:
When enabled, kube-proxy running on Windows will use
EndpointSlices as the primary data source instead of Endpoints, enabling scalability and
performance improvements. See
[Enabling Endpoint Slices](/docs/concepts/services-networking/endpoint-slices/).

name: WindowsGMSA
description: Enables passing of GMSA credential specs from pods to container runtimes.

name: WindowsGracefulNodeShutdown
description:
Enables support for windows node graceful shutdown in kubelet.
During a system shutdown, kubelet will attempt to detect the shutdown event
and gracefully terminate pods running on the node. See
[Graceful Node Shutdown](/docs/concepts/architecture/nodes/#graceful-node-shutdown)
for more details.

name: WindowsHostNetwork
description: Enables support for joining Windows containers to a hosts' network namespace.

name: WindowsHostProcessContainers
description: Enables support for Windows HostProcess containers.

name: WindowsRunAsUserName
description:
Enable support for running applications in Windows containers with as a
non-default user. See [Configuring RunAsUserName](/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-runasusername)
for more details.

name: WorkloadAwarePreemption
description:
Enables the support for [Workload-aware preemption](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/workload-aware-preemption/). This feature gate was removed in 1.37 and merged together with the `GenericWorkload` feature gate.

When enabled, if a PodGroup fails to schedule, the scheduler will use a workload-aware preemption
algorithm to select victims to preempt instead of the default pod preemption algorithm.

name: WorkloadWithJob
description:
Enables the Job controller to compile a Job's `.spec.scheduling` configuration into
[Workload](/docs/concepts/workloads/workload-api/) and [PodGroup](/docs/concepts/workloads/podgroup-api/) 
objects before it creates any Pods.
When `.spec.scheduling` is omitted, the Job defaults to the `Basic` scheduling policy. See
[Integrate with Workload APIs](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/job#integrate-with-workload-apis)
for details.

name: ZeroLimitedNominalConcurrencyShares
description:
Allow [priority & fairness](/docs/concepts/cluster-administration/flow-control/)
in the API server to use a zero value for the `nominalConcurrencyShares` field of
the `limited` section of a priority level.

name: ExtendWebSocketsToKubelet
description:
When ExtendWebSocketsToKubelet is enabled and a kubelet node advertises support,
exec/attach/portforward streams are proxied directly to the kubelet rather than
being translated or tunneled at the API server. Critically, the same
stream translation and tunneling handlers used at the API server are now set up
identically at the kubelet — the logic is simply moved closer to the container
runtime. This feature depends on NodeDeclaredFeatures graduating to beta so that
kubelet capability advertisement is reliable in production clusters.
